sector.description: Sector is a cybersecurity company specializing in penetration testing and security operations. As an AI R&D intern, I developed AI-powered tools to enhance their security workflows, built internal products, and contributed to the team's knowledge through research papers and presentations.

seo.title: Sector Internship - AI Research & Development
seo.description: AI Research & Development internship at Sector - Building AI tools for cybersecurity, penetration testing automation, and threat detection systems.

highlights: Built an AI Labeling System for the XOps internal platform, automating data classification and improving workflow efficiency
Authored 2 research papers on AI applications in cybersecurity and threat detection methodologies
Delivered research presentations to the Sector team, sharing insights on AI/ML techniques and best practices
Developed AI tools to accelerate penetration testing and cybersecurity operations
Built automated threat detection systems that identify and flag security vulnerabilities
Trained AI models on XOps data to automate data processing, improving efficiency by 20% over manual regex-based methods

testimonial.quote: Joseph demonstrated exceptional initiative in both development and research. His AI Labeling System became a core part of our XOps workflow, and his research presentations helped elevate the team's understanding of AI applications in security.

stockbit.description: Stockbit is Indonesia's leading social trading and investment platform with over 5 million users. As an AI Engineer intern on the Data Team, I worked closely with data engineers and ML specialists to build production-ready AI systems. I developed OCR pipelines for KYC automation using Google Cloud Vision API and trained custom models with Google Cloud AutoML to detect fraudulent documents and scam posts. Both products are actively used in production, processing thousands of documents daily.

seo.title: Stockbit/Bibit Internship - AI Engineer
seo.description: AI Engineer internship at Stockbit/Bibit - Developing OCR pipelines for KYC automation and fraud detection systems for Indonesia's leading investment platform.

highlights: Worked on the Data Team alongside data engineers and ML specialists to build production AI systems
Developed OCR pipeline using Google Cloud Vision API to auto-extract user data from Indonesian KTP (ID card) documents for KYC verification
Trained custom AI models with Google Cloud AutoML to detect fraudulent documents and flag scam/spam posts on the social trading platform
Both products shipped to production and are actively processing thousands of documents daily
Increased KYC verification speed by 40% and achieved 95% fraud detection accuracy
Collaborated with cross-functional teams including security, backend, and product to integrate AI solutions

teamPhoto.caption: With the Stockbit/Bibit Data Team in Jakarta

products.name: KYC OCR Pipeline
products.description: Built a document processing pipeline using Google Cloud Vision API to extract text from Indonesian KTP (ID card) photos. The system parses and validates key fields (name, ID number, date of birth, address) against user-submitted data, integrated with a FastAPI backend for real-time verification during the KYC onboarding flow.

products.name: Fraud Detection Model
products.description: Labeled training datasets from historically flagged posts and suspicious documents, then trained a classification model using Google Cloud AutoML. The model was integrated into the content moderation workflow to automatically flag potential scam posts and fraudulent KYC submissions for review.
